sections.title: Consolidation Goals
items: I can form and understand present participles in -ó/-ő and mediopassive verbs in -ódik/-ődik.
I can describe a full workday, responsibilities, and overtime accurately.
I can handle job applications and professional requirements (alkalmas, megfelel).
I can discuss meetings, deadlines, and long-term career growth.
